tolerance.note: Loose quantization reference, not a C# correctness check. The pinned int8 profile is compared against the fp32 base model; the threshold is deliberately below 0.99 because the measured int8 degradation is larger than that. Current fixture minimum is 0.979531; the 0.975 floor leaves a small margin.
